resolution.note: src/flow and krn review removed; krn review exits 64; 27 files edited; ADR 0014 amended; full suite green

title: krn review leaves
body:
Outcome: `src/flow` is gone; `krn review` exits 64 naming the command; the documents that name it are edited in the same PR.
Why: 368 `src` lines net (flow itself is 335) and 6 tests nobody on the shipping path calls (`04` (h)). It is not a free removal: `src/flow` is the opt-in judge panel of D10 and D22 (`src/flow/cli.ts:1`), and `src/flow/tier.ts` is the mitigation ADR 0014:59 names for the gate's residual; the patch edits that sentence. The amendments are in `adr-draft-subtraction.md` Part 1.
Proof: full suite green; `git grep -n "krn review" -- . ':!tasks'` finds only the retired-command test (today: 20 lines in 12 files).
Scope: the 27 files of `spike-h-c1.patch`.
Order: Both removals touch frame files; merge them before A5. After it, the App opens the PR, the operator's credential pushes the workflow commit into it and, under A4, the operator approves.
Carries: Part 1 of adr-draft-subtraction.md.
Program: .krn/runs/krn-architecture-program/05-program.md section 4, slice D1.
